why_this_tool: The open source MLflow Model Registry runs entirely on a laptop and exposes every idea in this lesson (named models, immutable versions, lineage to a run, aliases, tags and a standard package format) through one UI and one API.
alternatives: SageMaker Model Registry is a managed cloud registry built around model package groups and approval status, Unity Catalog adds three-level names and central access governance across workspaces, and a plain object store with container image tags is the do-it-yourself option with no lineage or aliases.

steps.why: An image built from a fixed version reference, and later referenced by its digest, pins both model and runtime immutably. This is the unit a deployment system actually ships.

steps.do: Reproduce the model's environment in a clean virtual environment from the dependency files stored in the package, then load and score it there.
steps.done_when: The model loads and scores in the new environment with no manually added packages.
steps.why: Pinned dependencies recorded with the artifact are what let CI or another machine rebuild the same runtime. A package that only works on the training laptop is not a release.

steps.done_when: A new version appears in the UI, its metadata is in the database, and its files are in the artifact store.
